Basilisk Cult
Mud-smeared warriors lurk inside the 
crumbling temple of an ancient cult!
The wicked stone shaman Uzaru is 
positioning her warriors to strike out 
at nearby Mivvin's Rest! The basilisk 
cultists prepare for pillaging and 
mayhem inside the halls of their 
fearsome temple where their basilisk 
hatchlings grow stronger each day.
